name: Battle: All-Out
author: Sixth Front
description: Pick ALL-OUT on the main menu: infantry, tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers and ships in one battle, up to 100 soldiers a side (the bots fill in for the players). Two maps about 3 km across: TWIN RIVERS (a navigable river into a lake on the east, a shallow river on the west, farms, villages and a downtown of skyscrapers) and HARBOUR CITY (the sea along the east, a river from an inland lake out to it, a skyscraper city on the coast). Each side has an airbase: a runway where your jets and bombers line up and roll down to take off, an apron with hangars, fuel tanks and a control tower, six helipads where the helicopters stand (they come back 20 seconds after they're lost), and a harbour for your ships.

battle.name: ALL-OUT
battle.blurb: Infantry, tanks, air and sea together
battle.tagline: Everything at once. Infantry, tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers and warships, up to 100 a side, on maps three kilometres across.

modes.name: CONQUEST
modes.blurb: Seven flags, every kind of fight

script: // Infantry, tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers and ships in one battle, on two maps about 3 km across with rivers,
// a lake or the sea, a downtown of skyscrapers and an airbase at each end: two parallel runways with a taxiway beside
// them (jets and bombers wait their turn on it in line and turn onto whichever runway is clear, two taking off side by
// side when both are; landed back at the base an aircraft can't be hit and is repaired and rearmed), an apron with hangars and a control tower, eight helipads right beside the
// HQ you spawn at (helicopters stand on them and come back 20 seconds after they're lost) and a harbour on the water. Up to 100 soldiers a side:
// the bots fill whatever the players don't.
const g = api.game, world = g.world, scene = g.scene;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const own = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, name), prev = obj[name], fn = make(prev);
undo.push(() => { if (obj[name] === fn) { if (own) obj[name] = prev; else delete obj[name]; } });
onOff(() => { for (const u of undo.splice(0).reverse()) { try { u(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } });
// runway (and runway2, parallel beyond it) / apron / pads: [x, z, length, width] along x; hangars [x, z]; tower [x, z]; harbour [x, z, yaw]
const rw = mirror(L.runway, team), rw2 = mirror(L.runway2, team), ap = mirror(L.apron, team), pc = mirror(L.pads, team);
// (both rolled down the same way, from the end the taxiway comes to; named the way a pilot rolling down them sees
// them: 9 heading east, L the one on the left)
const runways = [rw, rw2].map((r, i) => ({ x: r[0], z: r[1], len: r[2], wid: r[3], dir, id: i }));
for (const r of runways) { const o = runways[1 - r.id]; r.name = (dir > 0 ? '9' : '27') + ((dir > 0 ? r.z < o.z : r.z > o.z) ? 'L' : 'R'); }
// the taxiway: alongside the first runway on the apron side, from the end they're rolled down from (tx); planes wait
// on it in line, nose toward that end (u: how far along it from there; the front of the line 35 m along, room for
// planes back to 200 m), and turn onto a runway from the front
const taxi = { dir, zs, tx: rw[0] - dir * (rw[2] / 2 - 40), hz: rw[1] - zs * (rw[3] / 2 + 23), head: 35, room: 200 };
// (two rows of four, 40 m apart, starting 50 m from the HQ: a short walk from where you spawn)
team, runway: runways[0], runways, taxi, apron: { x: ap[0], z: ap[1], len: ap[2], wid: ap[3] },
padField: { x: pc[0], z: pc[1] }, pads, hangars: L.hangars.map((h) => mirror(h, team)), tower: mirror(L.tower, team),
fuel: L.fuel.map((f) => mirror(f, team)), harbour: { x: hb[0], z: hb[1], yaw: team === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI },
// the ships' harbour (the Naval mod reads it)
if (LAYOUT) { g.__harbours = BASES.map((b) => b.harbour); onOff(() => { delete g.__harbours; }); }
const add = (m) => { scene.add(m); made.push(m); return m; };

onOff(() => { for (const o of made) { if (o.parent) o.parent.remove(o); if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); if (o.material && o.material.dispose) o.material.dispose(); } for (const b of boxes) if (world.disableBox) world.disableBox(b); });
const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;

const speckle = (x, w, h, base, n, a) => { x.fillStyle = base; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = Math.random(); x.fillStyle = `rgba(${v > 0.5 ? 255 : 0},${v > 0.5 ? 255 : 0},${v > 0.5 ? 255 : 0},${a * Math.random()})`; x.fillRect(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, 2, 2); } };
// the runway: dark asphalt, the centre line, the edge lines, the threshold bars and the numbers at both ends
const runwayTex = (len, num) => canvasTex(128, 2048, (x, w, h) => {
x.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,30,30,0.35)'; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) x.fillRect(w * 0.3 + Math.random() * w * 0.4, Math.random() * h, 6, 60 + Math.random() * 200);
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const bx = 12 + i * 13.5 + (i > 3 ? 4 : 0); if (end) x.fillRect(bx, h - 60, 8, 50); else x.fillRect(bx, 10, 8, 50); }
if (end) { x.translate(w / 2, h - 110); x.fillText(String(num[1]), 0, 0); } else { x.translate(w / 2, 110); x.rotate(Math.PI); x.fillText(String(num[0]), 0, 0); }

const concreteTex = canvasTex(256, 256, (x, w, h) => { speckle(x, w, h, '#8f8c86', 5000, 0.1); x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,40,40,0.35)'; x.lineWidth = 2; for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(i * 64, 0); x.lineTo(i * 64, h); x.stroke(); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0, i * 64); x.lineTo(w, i * 64); x.stroke(); } }, [1, 1]);
x.strokeStyle = '#e6e2d6'; x.lineWidth = 9; x.beginPath(); x.arc(w / 2, h / 2, w * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2); x.stroke();
const flatMat = (map, color = 0xffffff) => keep(new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map, color, roughness: 0.92, metalness: 0, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -12 }));
const lay = (w, len, x, z, mat, y = 0.07) => {
hangar: std({ color: 0x7c8076, roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.35, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
const solid = (x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) => { if (world.addBox) boxes.push(world.addBox(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, { mat: 'metal' })); };
const rw = B.runway, rw2 = B.runways[1], ap = B.apron;
// two parallel runways, L and R the way a pilot rolling down them sees them: each end painted with the heading you
// take off on from it (9 at the west end, 27 at the east), the right way up for you as you roll
B.runways.forEach((r) => lay(r.wid, r.len, r.x, r.z, flatMat(runwayTex(r.len, r.dir > 0 ? [r.name, opp(r.name)] : [opp(r.name), r.name])), 0.13));
const ct = concreteTex.clone(); ct.needsUpdate = true; ct.repeat.set(ap.len / 40, ap.wid / 40); keep(ct);
// the taxiway beside the runways, where planes wait in line (a yellow line down the middle, and the double one they
// hold short of the runways at), and its way across to both runways at their end
const T = B.taxi, tt = concreteTex.clone(); tt.needsUpdate = true; tt.repeat.set(1, 6); keep(tt);
lay(40, Math.abs(rw2.z - T.hz) + 24, T.tx + T.dir * 4, (T.hz + rw2.z) / 2, tm, 0.065).rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
for (const u of [22, 23.2]) lay(22, 0.35, T.tx + T.dir * u, T.hz, yellow, 0.08);
const pct = concreteTex.clone(); pct.needsUpdate = true; pct.repeat.set(4, 2.2); keep(pct);
const m = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CircleGeometry(10, 32)), padMat));
m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; m.position.set(x, ground(x, z) + 0.09, z); m.receiveShadow = true;
// hangars: arched roofs with their doors facing the apron
const y0 = ground(x, z), face = B.team === 0 ? 1 : -1;
const roof = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(15, 15, 34, 20, 1, true, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI)), M.hangar));
roof.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2; roof.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2; roof.position.set(x, y0, z); roof.castShadow = true; roof.receiveShadow = true;
const back = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CircleGeometry(15, 20, 0, Math.PI)), M.hangar));
back.position.set(x, y0, z - face * 17); if (face < 0) back.rotation.y = Math.PI;
const door = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CircleGeometry(14.6, 20, 0, Math.PI)), M.dark));
door.position.set(x, y0, z + face * 16.9); if (face > 0) door.rotation.y = Math.PI;
const [x, z] = B.tower, y0 = ground(x, z);
const shaft = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.BoxGeometry(6, 18, 6)), M.wall)); shaft.position.set(x, y0 + 9, z); shaft.castShadow = true;
const cab = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(5.5, 4.6, 4, 8)), M.glass)); cab.position.set(x, y0 + 20, z);
const lid = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(6.2, 6.2, 0.6, 8)), M.dark)); lid.position.set(x, y0 + 22.3, z);
const mast = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 6, 6)), M.red)); mast.position.set(x, y0 + 25.6, z);
const t = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(7, 7, 9, 24)), M.tank)); t.position.set(x, y0 + 4.5, z); t.castShadow = true;
// the harbour: a pier out into the water
const pier = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.BoxGeometry(70, 1.2, 8)), M.pier));
if (LAYOUT) for (const B of BASES) buildBase(B);
// helicopters on a free helipad (and home to it), jets and bombers in line on the taxiway
const T = a.type, hb = T.hit && T.hit[0];
const big = a.kind === 'bomber', L = clamp(T.radius * (big ? 0.1 : 0.13), 0.75, big ? 2.4 : 1.6);
// A runway is in use while anything is on it, rolling down it, just off its far end or coming in low over it: from
// any game, so a plane another player flies counts too
if (Math.abs(o.pos.z - rw.z) > rw.wid / 2 + 15 || u < -rw.len / 2 - 80 || u > rw.len / 2 + 600) continue;
const freeRunway = (team, self) => { const B = BASES[team]; return B ? B.runways.find((rw) => runwayClear(rw, self)) || null : null; };
// Jets and bombers take their turn, the way they do at a real airbase. One that's to fly joins the back of the line on
// the taxiway, nose toward the runways' end, and taxis up behind the one in front of it each time the line moves; the
// one at the front holds short until a runway is clear, then taxis round onto it, lines up and rolls. Both runways are
// used at once: the far one first, so the next plane can turn onto the near one as soon as the first is across it, and
// the two take off side by side. It all goes by where the aircraft are, in any game, so planes other players' games fly
const onLine = (T, o) => !!o.takeoff && o.exists && o.alive && o.state === 'flying' && Math.abs(o.pos.z - T.hz) < 10 && o.pos.y - ground(o.pos.x, o.pos.z) < 8;
// (how far apart two wait, centre to centre, by their size)
// the plane in front of this one in the line
if ((ou < u - 0.5 || (Math.abs(ou - u) <= 0.5 && o.uid < a.uid)) && ou > bu) { bu = ou; best = o; }
// how far along the taxiway the next plane joins the line, or null when the line already goes back as far as it can
if (ou > -10 && ou > lu) { lu = ou; last = o; }
const u = last ? Math.max(T.head, lu + gapOf(last, self)) : T.head;
// May the plane at the front of the line go to this runway now? Not while anything's on it, rolling down it, just off
// its far end or coming in low over it (runwayClear), nor while anyone's out at the end on the way there (s: how far
// out from the taxiway toward the runways). And the far runway, across the near one, not while someone taking off from
// the near one could blow you over with their jet blast, nor while someone's coming in to land on it toward the end.
const T = B.taxi, r1 = B.runways[0], far = rw !== r1;
const reach = far ? (rw.z - T.hz) * T.zs + rw.wid / 2 + 10 : (r1.z - T.hz) * T.zs - r1.wid / 2 - 5;
const agl = o.pos.y - ground(o.pos.x, o.pos.z), u = along(T, o), s = (o.pos.z - T.hz) * T.zs;
if (agl < 30 && u > -45 && u < 70 && s > 8 && s < reach) return false;
if (agl < 30 && u > -120 && u < (o.kind === 'bomber' ? 350 : 250) && o.throttle > 0.6) return false;
phase: 'line', at: g.time, t: 0, v: 0, s: 0, x0: a.pos.x, z0: a.pos.z, dx: 1, dz: 0, gear: gearH(a), lift: 0, wait: 0, empty: 0,
vr: Math.max(a.type.flight.stall * 1.45, 50), acc: a.kind === 'bomber' ? 7 : 11, taxi: a.kind === 'bomber' ? 8 : 11,
const busy = (x, z) => A.fleet.some((o) => o !== a && o.exists && Math.hypot(o.pos.x - x, o.pos.z - z) < 14);
const [x, z] = free.length ? free[Math.floor(Math.random() * free.length)] : B.pads[Math.floor(Math.random() * B.pads.length)];
return { x, z, yaw: B.team === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI, alt: a.type.rest || 1.25 };
// jets and bombers: onto the taxiway at the back of the line (another game's goes to the front here, then follows
const T = B.taxi, back = a.mp && a.mp.remote ? null : backOfLine(a.team, a), u = back ?? T.head;
const x = T.tx + T.dir * u, z = T.hz;
return { x, z, yaw: yawOf(-T.dir, 0), y: ground(x, z) + a.takeoff.gear, speed: 0 };
const ZUP = new V3(0, 1, 0), _e = new THREE.Euler();
// on its wheels at (x, z), nose along (fx, fz), rolling at v
function groundPose(a, x, z, fx, fz, v, dt) {
const R = a.takeoff, yaw = yawOf(fx, fz);
a.yaw = yaw; a.pitch = 0; a.roll = 0; a.hYaw = yaw;
a.speed = Math.abs(v); a.vel.set(fx * v, 0, fz * v);
if (!a.gearDown) { a.gearDown = true; if (AIR0().gear) AIR0().gear(a, true); }
// back in the hangar (nobody at the controls)
a.exists = false; a.hull.visible = false; a.state = 'ready'; a.readyAt = g.time; a.respawnT = 0; a.ai = null;
// what the tower tells you while you wait your turn
const R = a.takeoff, B = BASES[a.team], T = B.taxi;
const u = along(T, a), n = AIR0().fleet.filter((o) => o !== a && onLine(T, o) && along(T, o) < u - 0.5).length;
msg = n > 0 ? `HOLDING ON THE TAXIWAY · ${n} AHEAD OF YOU` : 'HOLDING SHORT · WAITING FOR A CLEAR RUNWAY';
} else if (R.phase === 'turn') msg = `LINING UP ON RUNWAY ${B.runways[R.rw].name}`;
// in line: taxi up behind the plane in front, easing in; from the front, round onto a clear runway. (Two games that put
// a plane in the same place at once: the one that's to wait behind backs up to its place.)
const R = a.takeoff, B = BASES[a.team], T = B.taxi;
const u = along(T, a), ahead = lineAhead(T, a);
const spot = ahead ? Math.max(T.head, along(T, ahead) + gapOf(ahead, a)) : T.head;
const left = u - spot, top = Math.min(10, R.taxi);
const want = R.empty > 0 ? 0 : left > 0.2 ? Math.min(top, Math.sqrt(5 * left)) : left < -1 ? -Math.min(3, Math.sqrt(2 * -left)) : 0;
R.v = clamp(R.v + clamp(want - R.v, -4 * dt, 2.5 * dt), -3, top);
// (it stops at its place, never through it)
if (R.v > 0 && nu < spot) { nu = Math.min(u, spot); R.v = 0; } else if (R.v < 0 && nu > spot) { nu = Math.max(u, spot); R.v = 0; }
groundPose(a, T.tx + T.dir * nu, T.hz, -T.dir, 0, R.v, dt);
// (the far runway first when both are clear)
if (R.wait > 1.2) { const rw = [B.runways[1], B.runways[0]].find((r) => mayGo(B, r, a)); if (rw) startTurn(a, rw); }
// round onto the runway: a curve from where it is, nose as it points, to the runway's end, nose down it (from the
// front of the line: on to the end of the taxiway, then across, then round)
const R = a.takeoff, T = BASES[a.team].taxi, d = T.dir;
const fx = -Math.sin(a.yaw), fz = -Math.cos(a.yaw), x = a.pos.x, z = a.pos.z, end = [T.tx + d * 25, rw.z];
const k = Math.max(10, 0.4 * Math.hypot(end[0] - x, end[1] - z));
P1 = [x + fx * k, z + fz * k]; P2 = [end[0] - d * k, end[1]];
P1 = [x + fx * reach, z + fz * reach]; P2 = [T.tx - d * 10, rw.z];
R.phase = 'turn'; R.rw = rw.id; R.p = 0; R.v = Math.min(R.v || 0, R.taxi); R.wait = 0;
R.v = R.empty > 0 ? Math.max(0, R.v - 4 * dt) : Math.min(R.taxi, R.v + 2.5 * dt);
R.p = Math.min(1, R.p + (R.v * dt) / Math.max(1, Math.hypot(dx, dz)));
const [x, z] = bez(R.path, R.p), [tx, tz] = bezD(R.path, R.p), tl = Math.hypot(tx, tz);
groundPose(a, x, z, tl > 1e-3 ? tx / tl : T.dir, tl > 1e-3 ? tz / tl : 0, R.v, dt);
// lined up: full power down the runway
R.phase = 'roll'; R.x0 = x; R.z0 = z; R.s = 0; R.dx = T.dir; R.dz = 0; R.lift = 0; R.t = 0;
// the takeoff roll: full power down the runway, wheels down, the nose lifts at flying speed and it climbs away;
// then the pilot (or the bot) has it
// (with nobody at the controls it brakes to a stop instead)
if (R.empty > 0 && R.lift <= 0) R.v = Math.max(0, R.v - 6 * dt);
else R.v = Math.min(R.vr * 1.2, R.v + R.acc * dt);
let x = R.x0 + R.dx * R.s, z = R.z0 + R.dz * R.s, pitch = 0;
if (R.v >= R.vr) { R.lift += dt; pitch = Math.min(0.2, R.lift * 0.14); }
const y = ground(x, z) + R.gear + R.lift * R.lift * 3.2;
a.yaw = yaw; a.pitch = pitch; a.roll = 0; a.hYaw = yaw;
a.vel.set(R.dx * R.v, R.lift > 0 ? R.lift * 6.4 : 0, R.dz * R.v);
if (!a.gearDown) { a.gearDown = true; if (AIR0().gear) AIR0().gear(a, true); }
// airborne and climbing: hand over, gear up
// nobody at the controls (the pilot got out): it stops where it is and goes back to the hangar after a moment
// handed to this game partway through (another game had it until now): carry on from where it is
const T = B.taxi, up = a.pos.y - ground(a.pos.x, a.pos.z) - (R.gear || 0);
R.at = g.time; R.wait = 0; R.empty = 0; R.told = null;
if (Math.abs(a.pos.z - T.hz) < 10 && up < 4) { R.phase = 'line'; R.v = Math.min(R.v, 10); return; }
const on = B.runways.find((r) => Math.abs(a.pos.z - r.z) < r.wid / 2 + 4);
R.phase = 'roll'; R.x0 = a.pos.x; R.z0 = on.z; R.s = 0; R.dx = T.dir; R.dz = 0; R.t = 0;
const near = B.runways.reduce((p, c) => (Math.abs(a.pos.z - c.z) < Math.abs(a.pos.z - p.z) ? c : p));
startTurn(a, on || freeRunway(a.team, a) || near, true);
// At your own base (waiting to take off or rolling down the runway on its wheels; back on the ground, jets and bombers
// on a runway, the taxiway or the apron, wheels down and slow, helicopters sitting on their own helipads): it can't be
// hit, and after a moment back on the ground it's repaired, rearmed and its flares refilled
const p = a.pos, inRect = (r, m) => Math.abs(p.x - r.x) < r.len / 2 + m && Math.abs(p.z - r.z) < r.wid / 2 + m;
if (p.y - ground(p.x, p.z) > (a.type.rest || 1.25) + 1.2 || a.speed > 4) return false;
return B.pads.some(([x, z]) => Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.z - z) < 14);
const T = B.taxi, u = along(T, a);
return B.runways.some((rw) => inRect(rw, 8)) || inRect(B.apron, 8) || (Math.abs(p.z - T.hz) < 15 && u > -20 && u < 250);
const need = a.health < a.maxHealth - 0.5 || a.weps.some((w) => w.ammo < w.def.ammo) || a.flares < (a.type.flares ?? 2);
if (!need) { if (a._svc > 0 && a._svcTold && a.driver === g.player) g.hud.toast('REPAIRED AND REARMED'); a._svc = 0; a._svcTold = false; return; }
if (a.driver === g.player && !a._svcTold) { a._svcTold = true; g.hud.toast('SAFE AT BASE · REPAIRING AND REARMING'); }
// (the airframe a fifth a second, then the parts that came off, the weapons and the flares)
for (const w of a.weps) { w.ammo = w.def.ammo; w.cool = 0; w.rearm = 0; }
onOff(() => { if (A.launchSpot === launchSpot) { if (prevSpot) A.launchSpot = prevSpot; else delete A.launchSpot; } });
// (another game's: that game moves it; handed to this one partway through its takeoff, it carries on from there)
// at your own base: nothing can hurt it (and it can't fire) while it waits its turn and rolls, or while it's
// a jet or bomber goes only while there's room in the line on the taxiway; otherwise a bot stays on foot for now, and
// a player who deployed into one waits beside it on the apron
if (!pilot || (this.kind !== 'jet' && this.kind !== 'bomber') || (this.mp && this.mp.remote) || !BASES[this.team] || backOfLine(this.team, this) !== null) return prev.call(this, pilot);
if (parked.has(this)) { const x = this.pos.x + 8, z = this.pos.z; pilot.pos.set(x, ground(x, z) + 0.05, z); }
g.hud.toast('THE TAXIWAY IS FULL · GET IN WHEN THE LINE MOVES');
// helicopters come back 20 seconds after they're lost; more of everything in the air
for (const t of A.types) if (t.kind === 'heli') { const r = t.respawn; t.respawn = 20; onOff(() => { t.respawn = r; }); }
const keepMax = { heli: A.maxHeli, bots: A.maxBots };
// a second transport and a second of each attack helicopter a side
for (const t of A.types) if (t.kind === 'heli') for (const team of t.teams) {
if (A.fleet.filter((o) => o.type === t && o.team === team && !o.reserved).length < 2) A.addAircraft(t, team);
// your own jets and bombers (the ones you've bought) on the deploy screen, from the runway
const owns = (t, team) => { const C = g.__career; if (!C) return true; return !!((C.deployable && C.deployable('air', t.id, team)) || (C.owned && C.owned('air', t.id, team))); };
// (online every page has to build the same aircraft in the same order, so there it's one of every type for both
